part_name: OZ51x dual transmitter housing — snap service cover
description: Separate Opus 5 derivative with two hook/two release-tab cover, no cover inserts, preserved mounting interfaces and D-shaped central DE-9 front I/O.
material: Unfilled MJF PA12 nylon, black dyed; qualify snaps at actual service temperature.
process: MJF additive manufacturing. Separate base and cover. FDM coupon/prototype only.

fiber_bay._comment: v2 moves the R15 drum 7.5 mm away from the module partition. With the 1.5 mm retention flange, clear gap is 8 mm. Bay grows 4 mm to retain 3 mm between flange envelope and DE-9 rear keepout.

mounting_hardware.screw: M3 through screws into plate standoffs
mounting_hardware._comment: Representative M3 large-series flat washer envelope, check ordered hardware. Keep existing 4.5 x 9 slots and their locations for larger standoff/screw options.

fiber_service._comment: Routing clearances are design targets, not human-factors qualification or fiber specifications. Preserve the inherited 15 mm bend-radius surface.

panel_connector.type: Amphenol L177SDE09S candidate, flange outside panel, custom power/control harness

notes: FRONT I/O is canonical +Y: two SC/APC fiber outputs and shared DE-9. SMA RF/TTL inputs are on -Y.
No inherited electrical pin assignment is approved. RF family data support eight shared nets; exact TTL pinout must be confirmed before harness wiring.
No cover inserts or screws; module and connector mounting hardware remains. Production release requires latch and exact-hardware qualification.
